items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Tanyah' as the source of a track from 1973; INTERVIEWEE does not mention Tanyah, only redirects conversation to Randy and Gloria Lynne.

ctx.x: That’s like the [?]. That’s understood. He doesn’t have to spell it out. But that’s really unique, that version of it, and that’s from the – that one is from the new album, right? Earth Birth. And the one we heard before was from Tanyah, and that was 1973. Now we’re going to hear something else from . . .
No. Let’s leave Randy alone now and listen to Gloria Lynne’s Hi-Fly.
